# 1 Chronicles Chapter 1 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folios 370r–370v | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/1CH_001_page_001.jpg, 1CH_001_page_002.jpg

---

**1:1** Adam, Shet, Enosh. **1:2** Qenan, Mahalal'el, Yered. **1:3** Chanokh, Metushelach, Lemekh. **1:4** Noach, Shem, Cham, and-Yefet.

**1:5** The-sons of-Yefet: Gomer, and-Magog, and-Maday, and-Yavan, and-Tuval, and-Meshekh, and-Tiras. **1:6** And-the-sons of-Gomer: Ashkenaz, and-Rifat, and-Togarmah. **1:7** And-the-sons of-Yavan: Elishah, and-Tarshishah, Kittim, and-Dodanim.

**1:8** The-sons of-Cham: Kush, and-Mitsrayim, Put, and-Kena'an. **1:9** And-the-sons of-Kush: Seva, and-Chavilah, and-Savta, and-Ra'ma, and-Savtekha. And-the-sons of-Ra'ma: Sheva, and-Dedan. **1:10** And-Kush fathered [yalad] Nimrod; he began to-be a-mighty-one [gibbor] in-the-earth.

**1:11** And-Mitsrayim fathered the-Ludim, and-the-Anamim, and-the-Lehavim, and-the-Naftuchim, **1:12** and-the-Patrusim, and-the-Kasluchim — from-whom came-out the-Pelishtim — and-the-Kaftorim.

**1:13** And-Kena'an fathered Tsidon his-firstborn, and-Chet, **1:14** and-the-Yevusi, and-the-Emori, and-the-Girgashi, **1:15** and-the-Chivvi, and-the-Arqi, and-the-Sini, **1:16** and-the-Arvadi, and-the-Tsemari, and-the-Chamati.

**1:17** The-sons of-Shem: Eilam, and-Ashur, and-Arpakhshad, and-Lud, and-Aram, and-Uts, and-Chul, and-Geter, and-Meshekh. **1:18** And-Arpakhshad fathered Shelach, and-Shelach fathered Ever. **1:19** And-to-Ever were-born two sons: the-name of-the-one [was] Peleg, for in-his-days the-earth was-divided [niflegah]; and-the-name of-his-brother [was] Yoqtan. **1:20** And-Yoqtan fathered Almodad, and-Shelef, and-Chatsarmavet, and-Yerach, **1:21** and-Hadoram, and-Uzal, and-Diqlah, **1:22** and-Eival, and-Avima'el, and-Sheva, **1:23** and-Ofir, and-Chavilah, and-Yovav. All these [were] the-sons of-Yoqtan.

**1:24** Shem, Arpakhshad, Shelach, **1:25** Ever, Peleg, Re'u, **1:26** Serug, Nachor, Terach, **1:27** Avram — he [is] Avraham.

**1:28** The-sons of-Avraham: Yitschaq, and-Yishma'el.

**1:29** These [are] their-genealogies [toldotam]: the-firstborn of-Yishma'el — Nevayot, and-Qedar, and-Adbe'el, and-Mivsam, **1:30** Mishma, and-Dumah, Massa, Chadad, and-Teima, **1:31** Yetur, Nafish, and-Qedmah. These [are] the-sons of-Yishma'el.

**1:32** And-the-sons of-Qeturah, concubine of-Avraham: she-bore Zimran, and-Yoqshan, and-Medan, and-Midyan, and-Yishbaq, and-Shuach. And-the-sons of-Yoqshan: Sheva, and-Dedan. **1:33** And-the-sons of-Midyan: Eifah, and-Eifer, and-Chanokh, and-Avida, and-Elda'ah. All these [were] the-sons of-Qeturah.

**1:34** And-fathered Avraham Yitschaq. The-sons of-Yitschaq: Esav, and-Yisra'el.

**1:35** The-sons of-Esav: Elifaz, Re'u'el, and-Ye'ush, and-Ya'lam, and-Qorach. **1:36** The-sons of-Elifaz: Teman, and-Omar, Tsefi, and-Ga'tam, Qenaz, and-Timna, and-Amaleq. **1:37** The-sons of-Re'u'el: Nachat, Zerach, Shammah, and-Mizzah.

**1:38** And-the-sons of-Se'ir: Lotan, and-Shoval, and-Tsiv'on, and-Anah, and-Dishon, and-Etser, and-Dishan. **1:39** And-the-sons of-Lotan: Chori, and-Homam. And-the-sister of-Lotan: Timna. **1:40** The-sons of-Shoval: Alyan, and-Manachat, and-Eival, Shefi, and-Onam. And-the-sons of-Tsiv'on: Ayyah, and-Anah. **1:41** The-sons of-Anah: Dishon. And-the-sons of-Dishon: Chamran, and-Eshban, and-Yitran, and-Keran. **1:42** The-sons of-Etser: Bilhan, and-Za'avan, Ya'aqan. The-sons of-Dishan: Uts, and-Aran.

**1:43** And-these [are] the-kings who reigned in-the-land of-Edom before [the] reigning of-a-king for-the-sons of-Yisra'el: Bela son of-Be'or, and-the-name of-his-city [was] Dinhavah. **1:44** And-died Bela, and-reigned in-his-place Yovav son of-Zerach from-Botsrah. **1:45** And-died Yovav, and-reigned in-his-place Chusham from-the-land of-the-Temani. **1:46** And-died Chusham, and-reigned in-his-place Hadad son of-Bedad, the-one-who-struck Midyan in-the-field of-Moav; and-the-name of-his-city [was] Avit. **1:47** And-died Hadad, and-reigned in-his-place Samlah from-Masreqah. **1:48** And-died Samlah, and-reigned in-his-place Sha'ul from-Rechovot the-River. **1:49** And-died Sha'ul, and-reigned in-his-place Ba'al-Chanan son of-Akhbor. **1:50** And-died Ba'al-Chanan, and-reigned in-his-place Hadad; and-the-name of-his-city [was] Pa'i, and-the-name of-his-wife [was] Meheitav'el daughter of-Matred, daughter of-Mey-Zahav.

**1:51** And-died Hadad. And-the-chiefs [allufey] of-Edom: chief Timnah, chief Alvah, chief Yetet, **1:52** chief Oholivamah, chief Elah, chief Pinon, **1:53** chief Qenaz, chief Teman, chief Mivtsar, **1:54** chief Magdi'el, chief Iram. These [are] the-chiefs of-Edom.

---
## EMET's Textual Notes

**v.1 — No narrative introduction:** The Chronicler begins abruptly with "Adam, Seth, Enosh" — no creation account, no Eden, no fall. The genealogy is stripped to its structural function: a line from Adam to Israel.

**v.17 — Uts, Chul, Geter, Meshekh:** In Genesis 10:23, these are sons of Aram; the Chronicler lists them as sons of Shem directly. This is likely a textual compression, not a contradiction — the Chronicler abbreviates freely.

**v.27 — "Avram — he is Avraham":** The Chronicler notes the name change without narrating it. The entire Abrahamic covenant story is condensed into a parenthetical identification.

**v.36 — "and-Timna, and-Amaleq":** In Genesis 36:12, Timna is Eliphaz's concubine who bears Amalek. The Chronicler lists them both as sons, flattening the genealogical structure. This is characteristic of the Chronicler's compression technique.

*— EMET*
